headline.label: Lung cancer, symptoms to treatment (national study)
headline.detail: Average in an unpublished study of four study cities (Kuopio, Tampere, Turku, Rovaniemi). Study sites, not regions.

source.label: Yle MOT on the Kuittinen study (unpublished)

headline.label: Of those days, in primary care (national study)
headline.detail: Same study. The primary-care share of the delay, not a route comparison. Over 50 days are on the patient side and 58 in specialised care.

source.label: Yle MOT on the Kuittinen study (unpublished)

headline.label: Spread data recorded, solid cancers, Finland
headline.detail: Spread data (TNM, stage or free text) recorded for 41.9% of solid cancers in 2024; 58.1% had none. Stage alone was 5.4%. Clinical notifications reach only about half of new cases.

source.label: Cancer Registry 2024 factsheet (figure not yet checked by hand)

headline.label: Route gap, lymphoma (national, one study)
headline.detail: Median days, symptoms to treatment: primary healthcare vs private or occupational care. One national lymphoma cohort (n = 160). No county-level route data exists.

source.label: Kuitunen et al., Cancer Medicine 2026 (lymphoma routes)

headline.label: Clinical notifications, Pirkanmaa
headline.detail: Share of cancers notified to the registry by clinical staff, 2022 to 2024. Wellbeing services county.

comparisons.title: Lung cancer: median days from diagnosis to surgery
comparisons.note: Cooperation areas, not counties. Interquartile ranges: North 0.0 to 44.0; South 33.0 to 63.0. Diagnosis years are not stated in the PDF text.

goal3.name: Potilaat pääsevät hoitoon tavoiteaikojen puitteissa
goal3.howVitruvianMoves: No county cancer wait is published against target times yet, so Vitruvian shows proxy waits (route days and access times) for the county to track.

goal3.name: Alueelliset ja sosioekonomiset erot syövän ilmaantuvuudessa, hoidossa ja syöpäkuolleisuudessa ovat käytettävissä palvelutoiminnassa ja niillä ohjataan toimintaa
goal3.howVitruvianMoves: Vitruvian puts regional gaps side by side, such as lung surgery days North and South, so services can steer by them.

goal3.name: Saatavilla on luotettavaa tietoa syövän diagnostiikka- ja hoitokäytäntöjen alueellisista eroista, minkä avulla voidaan kaventaa eroja hoitotuloksissa
goal3.howVitruvianMoves: Vitruvian shows where the regional data is missing or thin, such as stage recording, so a county can see the gap it must close.

goal3.name: Kliinisten syöpäilmoitusten määrä (tavoitteena 90 % tapauksista automatisoidusti vuoteen 2030 mennessä)
goal3.howVitruvianMoves: Vitruvian tracks the county notification share against the 90% automated target, starting from Pirkanmaa at 80% in 2024.

goal3.name: Laaturekisterin tietopohja (ml. levinneisyystieto) … (tietopohjan kattavuus 90 %)
goal3.howVitruvianMoves: Vitruvian shows how much of each county record includes stage (spread) data, against the 90% coverage target.
